description.value: Fresh St. Market is a BC grocery chain with a strong focus on fresh and locally sourced products, operating a full-format supermarket at the West Esplanade Street location in North Vancouver. The store carries a wide range of departments including a deli with prepared foods and ready-to-eat meals, bakery, produce, seafood, and household goods — making it a capable resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through the area. The North Vancouver location sits near the waterfront, convenient for cyclists coming off the North Shore routes.
